title: Spyglass key
description: Spyglass Key lets you use a vanilla spyglass with a configurable keybind, without keeping it in your hotbar.
body: Spyglass Key lets you use a vanilla spyglass with a configurable keybind, without keeping it in your hotbar. As long as you have a spyglass in your inventory, holding the key temporarily equips and uses it with fully vanilla behavior, then returns everything back when released.
